name: core
title: ARLing Motion core
description: The motion core every component uses: closed-form springs as pure functions of time, tracks, a two edge indicator, presence for content, a live driver and demo beats. No dependencies. Also adds the springs as CSS variables (--arling-spring-snappy and others).
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
ARLing Motion core (MIT), installed at lib/arling-motion.js with lib/arling-motion.d.ts.
import { track, indicator, presence, driver, PRESETS, cssEasing } from "@/lib/arling-motion".
The springs were added to your global CSS as variables, for example
transition: transform var(--arling-spring-snappy-duration) var(--arling-spring-snappy);
Docs: https://arling.sk/motion/
